name: 下游来的领兵骑士
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:1587
who: The nameless knight who led the king's eight hundred up from the lower river against the bridge at Roaring Cliff, a human knight in his early forties: about 182 cm, broad through the chest and shoulders, a horseman's straight back. Short dark auburn hair and a close-trimmed auburn beard, tired amber eyes, a pale old scar across the bridge of the nose. On his head a plain bronze knight's circlet with no gem in it at all, in an age when every crown is crowded with stones. His king's arms, a black raven holding a lump of ore in its beak, are on his shield and chest. A dutiful, weary, honest air; he obeys and does not like it.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered man's face of about forty-two, tired amber eyes under straight auburn brows, a pale old scar across the bridge of the nose, a close-trimmed dark auburn beard, a firm closed mouth, faint lines at the eyes. Skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 182 cm, broad-chested and square-shouldered, a horseman's upright build.
palette: raven black, dull bronze, dark auburn, river slate blue, ore grey
casual: In camp on the lower river: a long slate-blue wool tunic closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the black raven holding a lump of grey ore embroidered on the chest, a broad leather belt with a straight sword at the left hip (on the viewer's right when he faces us), dark trousers and riding boots, a brown riding cloak; the plain gemless bronze circlet on his head. A pair of riding gloves held in the right hand. A tired, steady look.
private: Off duty by the horse lines: an undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow under an unlaced quilted arming vest, dark trousers, boots; no circlet, no sword. He holds a horse brush in one hand and a coil of halter rope in the other. A quiet, tired look.
battle: Ready to lead the charge, in a king's knight's refitted harness: an old mail hauberk to the knee, over it a bronze-hide cuirass bought from the Black Stone highlands and re-strapped to fit him, its pressed wolf-hide plates dull bronze; plain steel pauldrons and gauntlets with no gems in any setting; a slate-blue surcoat cut short; the plain bronze circlet riveted round an open-faced steel helm. On his left arm a long kite shield painted with the black raven holding grey ore. In his right hand a long ash lance with a narrow slate-blue pennon; the straight sword at his left hip (on the viewer's right when he faces us), its crossguard set with one small amber beast core he cut himself, glowing a slow dull gold. A grim, unwilling look.
formal: Reporting to his king: the slate-blue surcoat with the black raven holding ore across the chest over a clean mail shirt, a dark cloak pinned with a plain bronze brooch, the gemless bronze circlet on his head, the sword at the left hip (on the viewer's right when he faces us), the open helm held under his right arm. He stands straight, the eyes lowered a little, a closed, careful mouth.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned three-quarters, the tired amber eyes looking past the viewer at something far off for a long moment. Cold grey river-mist light from one side, a faint warm glint of bronze from the other. Foreground blur: the slate-blue pennon of a raised lance and fine spray of white water.
gear: 灵格（估）｜中｜照常｜2档｜替王领八百人冲桥的骑士，冠上一颗宝石也没有，家境中等，估灵格；改合身的旧锁甲加黑石买来的铜皮胸甲，盾画衔矿石的鸦，招牌是剑格里自己斩的一颗暗核。
